meta.name: Phone Number Lifecycle MVP seed catalog
meta.notice: Prototype evidence only. Dynamic prices, stock, supported countries and activation rules must be rechecked before purchase.

serviceRules.name: Claude
serviceRules.summary: Claude asks for a phone number from a supported location during account creation and sends a six-digit code by SMS.
serviceRules.retentionAdvice: Use a number you control long enough to recover or maintain the account; do not build a long-term account around a disposable number.

source.label: Claude Help Center — Verify your phone number

serviceRules.name: OpenAI API
serviceRules.summary: ChatGPT account creation and ChatGPT usage no longer require phone verification. Phone verification is currently required when generating the first OpenAI API key.
serviceRules.retentionAdvice: Prefer a user-controlled mobile number. OpenAI limits how often a number can be used for initial API-key phone verification.

source.label: OpenAI Help Center — What does phone verification look like?

serviceRules.name: WhatsApp
serviceRules.summary: First registration requires control of the phone number and a code delivered by SMS or phone call.
serviceRules.retentionAdvice: Keep control of the associated number. A temporary number is a poor long-term foundation because re-registration and recovery can require that number again.

source.label: WhatsApp Help Center — Can't register phone number

serviceRules.name: Telegram
serviceRules.summary: Telegram accounts are connected to a mobile number; landlines are not supported.
serviceRules.retentionAdvice: Keep access to the connected number or change the Telegram number while you still control the old account.

source.label: Telegram FAQ — Your Account / Login and SMS

serviceRules.name: Google Account
serviceRules.summary: Google may request phone verification in some account-creation or sign-in situations. Google recommends a user-controlled SMS-capable mobile number for recovery.
serviceRules.retentionAdvice: A recovery number should remain under your control. Do not use a disposable number for an account you care about.

source.label: Google Account Help — Add your phone number

routes.name: giffgaff UK mobile number
routes.form: physical SIM or eSIM on supported devices

cost.purchase: Physical SIM ordering is free from giffgaff, but delivery is UK-address only; eSIM is available through the giffgaff app. Recheck current plan/credit cost before activation.
cost.recurring: No fixed monthly plan is required for the inactivity rule itself. Perform at least one qualifying use or airtime/plan purchase within every 6 months.

retention.rule: Do at least one qualifying action before six months of inactivity: a qualifying call/SMS/MMS, mobile-data connection, airtime credit purchase or plan purchase.
retention.recovery: Once deactivated for inactivity the SIM cannot be reactivated. giffgaff says a PAC may be requested from agents within 30 days after deactivation to move the number to another UK network.

friction.identity: Current account/payment requirements must be checked at signup; the cited help pages do not establish a universal passport/KYC requirement.
friction.location: Physical SIM delivery is UK-address only. Roaming is supported in many countries, but Wi-Fi Calling is not supported abroad. eSIM activation geography still needs explicit verification before production.
friction.device: Unlocked compatible phone required; eSIM requires a supported device and the giffgaff app.
friction.ongoing: Very low-frequency keep-alive action; set a reminder well before the 6-month inactivity boundary.

routes.name: Lebara UK PAYG mobile number
routes.form: physical SIM; eSIM on supported devices

cost.purchase: Physical PAYG SIM is currently offered free; plans currently start from GBP 5. Recheck checkout and delivery availability.
cost.recurring: PAYG is available without a fixed 30-day plan. A chargeable activity is needed within 90 days to avoid temporary barring/credit loss; after a further 365 days without usage or top-up/plan purchase the SIM expires.

retention.rule: Make at least one chargeable activity before 90 consecutive days of inactivity. If barred after 90 days, add credit or buy a plan to resume service. After a further 365 days with no usage or top-up/plan purchase, the SIM expires and a new number is required.
retention.recovery: Top up or buy a plan during the recoverable inactivity period. For a critical account, do not wait until final expiry before porting or changing recovery numbers.

friction.identity: A universal passport/ID requirement has not been established by the official pages reviewed. eSIM purchase requires a Lebara account and verified email.
friction.location: Critical constraint: Lebara says the SIM/eSIM must be activated in the UK before taking it abroad. eSIM can be ordered outside the UK but must be activated in the UK.
friction.device: Unlocked phone required. eSIM support is device-dependent and currently phased; confirm your device before purchase.
friction.ongoing: PAYG or plan-based. International roaming outside included regions may require PAYG credit or a roaming add-on.

evidence.label: Lebara UK — eSIM help and UK activation requirement
Lebara UK — SIM inactivity and expiry
Lebara UK — free PAYG SIM

cost.purchase: Current build-your-own plans include a USD 5/30-day option; recheck plan pricing and taxes before purchase.
cost.recurring: Paid plans renew every 30 days. Wi-Fi Calling/Text can be used abroad after successful US activation; standard roaming outside promotions uses PAYG credit.

retention.rule: Keep an active paid plan and valid payment method. Tello plans run on 30-day cycles; this reminder is intentionally a few days early.
retention.recovery: Follow current Tello number-transfer/account-recovery rules; do not allow a critical-account number to lapse before changing recovery details elsewhere.

friction.identity: Check current checkout eligibility. Wi-Fi Calling requires a US E911 emergency address on the account.
friction.location: Critical constraint: first activation or port-in must be completed while physically in the United States and connected to a US cellular tower. After activation, Wi-Fi Calling/Text and supported roaming can work abroad.
friction.device: Unlocked compatible phone required; eSIM requires a compatible device and one-time QR activation.
friction.ongoing: 30-day paid plan. For non-Europe standard roaming, PAYG credit is required; Wi-Fi Calling/Text can receive OTPs abroad when configured.

cost.purchase: Ultra directs PayGo buyers to eBay or select T-Mobile stores. Acquisition price and availability are channel-specific and separate from the $3 / 30-day service charge.
cost.recurring: USD 3 per 30-day cycle includes 100 minutes, 100 texts and 100MB data; taxes, overage, roaming wallet and add-ons are separate.

retention.rule: Keep at least the USD 3 recurring charge available before each 30-day renewal. Auto Renew can be configured from the PayGo account; insufficient balance can suspend service.
retention.recovery: Ultra’s current terms allow a suspension/replenishment window before cancellation, but the exact window depends on remaining balance. Restore service before cancellation; after account cancellation, do not assume the number is recoverable.

friction.identity: Current activation/account requirements still need explicit verification for non-US residents before production.
friction.location: International roaming is supported for voice/SMS/MMS through PayGo Wallet credit, but initial activation-location requirements still need explicit verification.
friction.device: Unlocked compatible phone and PayGo SIM required.
friction.ongoing: USD 3 per 30-day base plan; acquisition price, taxes, optional roaming wallet and add-ons are separate.

Ultra Mobile — International Roaming

routes.name: H2O Wireless Pay As You Go US number
routes.form: prepaid SIM/eSIM options must be rechecked at purchase

cost.purchase: Plan/refill selection is dynamic; current official terms describe USD 10/20/30 Pay As You Go refills with 90-day expiry and USD 100 with 365-day expiry.
cost.recurring: Balance can roll over when recharged before expiry under the stated Pay As You Go terms. Recheck the current refill product before buying.

retention.rule: For a 90-day refill, recharge before the balance/plan expiration date. The reminder is deliberately early. Current terms say the account and number are cancelled after the balance remains at USD 0 for 30 consecutive days.
retention.recovery: Do not wait for cancellation on a number tied to important accounts; refill or port/change recovery numbers while the line is active.

friction.identity: Signup/KYC requirements are not yet fully verified for the intended overseas-user scenarios.
friction.location: Initial activation and overseas SMS/roaming behavior still require explicit official-source verification before this route can be production-ranked for users outside the US.
friction.device: Confirm device/network compatibility and current SIM/eSIM availability before purchase.
friction.ongoing: Refill-expiry management rather than a simple monthly subscription; zero balance for 30 consecutive days can cancel the number.

evidence.label: H2O Wireless — Terms and Conditions

routes.name: Mobal Japan Voice+Data 5G number
routes.form: physical SIM or eSIM with a real 070/080/090 Japanese mobile number

cost.purchase: Current official list pricing shows a JPY 4,950 SIM purchase price before temporary promotions; recheck checkout because discounts change.
cost.recurring: Voice+Data plans currently start from JPY 1,650 per calendar month. Outgoing calls/SMS and optional roaming can add charges.

retention.rule: Keep the monthly service active. Mobal states that if the service is terminated, the assigned Japanese phone number is lost and a future service requires a new number.
retention.recovery: Do not cancel a Mobal line tied to important accounts until those accounts have been migrated. A terminated Mobal number is not retained for later reuse.

friction.identity: Voice-capable products require identity verification under Japanese law. Delivery requires an accepted ID upload and delivery to the address shown on the ID; collection requires the physical valid passport. Voice customers must be 18+.
friction.location: Orders can be arranged with worldwide delivery or Japan pick-up. Activation requests are submitted through the Mobal account; the line receives its Japanese number only after activation. Japan pick-up requires passport presentation.
friction.device: Unlocked compatible phone required. For voice, device/VoLTE compatibility matters; eSIM requires native eSIM support.
friction.ongoing: Monthly service until manually terminated. International voice/SMS roaming is an optional paid feature on the latest Voice+Data 5G product; data roaming is not supported.

evidence.label: Mobal Japan — Voice+Data pricing and Japanese phone number

cost.purchase: The official Kaktus shop currently lists a 2 GB starter SIM for 150 CZK with 100 CZK credit and also lists a free starter with 10 CZK credit. Recheck the exact physical-SIM/eSIM choice at checkout.
cost.recurring: No fixed monthly plan is required for the prepaid line itself, but Kaktus requires at least one credit top-up every 12 months. The official online card top-up page currently starts at 50 CZK.

retention.rule: Top up credit at least once every 12 months. Kaktus states that failing to top up at least once in 12 months automatically ends the service and contract.
retention.recovery: No number-recovery grace window was found in the reviewed first-party sources. Do not wait until the 12-month boundary.

friction.identity: A universal passport/ID requirement has not been established by the official Kaktus pages reviewed.
friction.location: Kaktus official checkout states that SIM activation from abroad is not possible. Treat activation in the Czech Republic as the hard rule even though community reports describe inconsistent support exceptions.
friction.device: Unlocked compatible phone required. Kaktus terms support physical SIM and eSIM; eSIM requires a compatible device and activation QR code.
friction.ongoing: Top up at least once every 12 months. The official online card top-up form accepts EU-issued cards; users with other foreign cards need another official top-up method.

evidence.label: Kaktus — official SIM purchase page

routes.name: Mainland China official carrier SIM
routes.provider: China Mobile / China Unicom / China Telecom
routes.form: in-person registered physical SIM from an official operator business hall

cost.purchase: Official guidance says there is no processing fee; plan/package charges depend on the selected carrier and current tariff.
cost.recurring: Carrier/package-specific. Recharge can be made through official business halls, operator apps and online service halls.

retention.rule: Retention, recharge and suspension rules depend on the selected Chinese carrier and plan; this MVP does not invent one generic expiry rule.
retention.recovery: If the phone/SIM is lost, contact the carrier promptly. For important accounts, keep the line active or migrate account recovery before cancelling it.

friction.identity: Foreign nationals may use a passport or Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card. Current 2026 telecom guidance says the applicant must appear in person and cannot have another person apply on their behalf.
friction.location: This route requires being in Mainland China and visiting a self-operated carrier business hall. Beijing guidance says processing and issuance are immediate when the application is accepted.
friction.device: Current telecom guidance recommends a phone supporting 5G or VoLTE; carrier/device compatibility should be checked at the business hall.
friction.ongoing: Plan, top-up and number-retention rules vary by China Mobile, China Unicom or China Telecom.

evidence.label: China government — SIM card guide for foreigners
Beijing government — SIM card application procedure
MIIT Tianjin — 2026 foreign-national SIM application guide

retention.recovery: Do not use for an account that depends on future access to the same number.

friction.device: No SIM installation for the temporary verification workflow.
